# Examples

Small programs that use the library the way production code would, each a `main` package with realistic data and a comment saying where the idea is used in real software. Run any of them:

```bash
go run ./examples/leaderboard
go run ./examples/http-cache
go run ./examples/leader-election
```

`go test ./examples/` builds and runs every one, so they never fall behind the packages they use. `algorithm info ID` and the site's entry pages link each entry to its program; the table below is generated from those links (`go run ./tools/gendocs`).
